- Unfolding the diagonal fold reflects the cut into a larger triangle wedge.
- Unfolding the horizontal fold doubles it again.
- Unfolding the vertical fold completes the pattern.

The 8 reflected copies of the cut triangle (each with a vertex at the center and edges along the fold lines) tile together exactly into a **square** whose sides are parallel to the vertical and horizontal fold lines — an axis-aligned square hole in the middle of the octagon.
